findings.text: The playtest step can pass before the server answers; wait for the finished state.
Line 21 promises the original name, but only the cleaned name is stored.
Only one fallback status is handled; say what happens to the other one, and add a test.
The store's confinement is checked on send only; check it on write and serve too, with a test.
Stored files are never deleted, so the folder grows without limit.
Promised doc updates have no acceptance criterion.
